verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents export to open formats (PPTX, PDF, HTML), and a Claude team member states the designs themselves are HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle. A user also reports that data export includes the design code. However, there is no first-party documentation of the native project format. Portability has caveats: SVG export strips animations unless you work around it, and users report losing access to projects after unsubscribing. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the native design/project file format, guaranteed export access independent of subscription, lossless export (e.g. SVG animations), independent confirmation that exported code is toolable/maintainable outside the editor

support.subject: As a developer, the file format is open or documented, so my designs stay portable and toolable outside the vendor's editor

citations.quote: Export to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, share an org-scoped link, hand off to Claude Code, or send to the apps you already use daily.
Claude's designs are HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle
If you export your data, all your Claude Design chats are in a design_chats directory along with the code
